scenes.say: Onions make you cry on purpose. It's a chemical weapon.
Onions grow underground, where animals want to eat them. So they defend themselves.
scenes.heading: THE REASON

scenes.say: When you cut one, you break open its cells. Chemicals inside mix and turn into a gas.
scenes.heading: WHEN YOU CUT

scenes.say: That gas floats up into your eyes, and irritates the nerves there.
So your eyes flood with tears, to wash it away.
scenes.heading: YOUR DEFENSE

scenes.say: Want to cry less? Chill the onion first, and use a really sharp knife. Fewer broken cells, less gas.
scenes.heading: THE HACK

scenes.say: Scientists in Japan even grew an onion that doesn't make you cry.
scenes.heading: BONUS
